"""Discard an unescaped int temporary used only by an adjacent int predicate.

No native recovery claim: this is a bounded C-source transformation.
"""
import collections,json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/recovery')
from canonicalize_helpers import read,span,mask,sha

helpers='valid_target validate_target is_humiliated eot_trigger discard_trigger resolve_gfp_ability end_of_combat_trigger new_specific_spell_played'.split()
pattern=re.compile(r'(?m)^(?P<indent> +)result = (?P<call>(?P<helper>'+ '|'.join(helpers)+r')\([^;\n]*\));\n(?P=indent)if \(result (?P<op>!=|==) 0\)')
declaration=re.compile(r'(?m)^  int result;\n')
def project(body):
 code=mask(body)
 if '#' in code or '/*' in code or '*/' in code or re.search(r'\b(?:asm|__asm|__asm__)\b',code):return None
 if len(re.findall(r'\bresult\b',code))!=3:return None
 decls=list(declaration.finditer(code));matches=list(pattern.finditer(body))
 if len(decls)!=1 or len(matches)!=1:return None
 d=decls[0];m=matches[0]
 if code[:d.start()].count('{')-code[:d.start()].count('}')!=1:return None
 if code[m.start():m.start()+len(m['indent'])+6]!=m['indent']+'result':return None
 if code[d.start():d.end()]!=body[d.start():d.end()]:return None
 # Public declarations establish int results, so dropping assignment conversion
 # cannot change the tested truth value. Reject shadowed helper identifiers.
 if len(re.findall(r'\b'+m['helper']+r'\b',code))!=1:return None
 after=body[:m.start()]+m['indent']+'if ('+('!' if m['op']=='==' else '')+m['call']+')'+body[m.end():]
 after=after[:d.start()]+after[d.end():]
 assert not re.search(r'\bresult\b',mask(after))
 assert mask(after).count('{')==mask(after).count('}')
 return after,dict(helper=m['helper'],comparison=m['op']+' 0',call=m['call'])

positive='int sample(target_definition_t *td)\n{\n  int result;\n  result = valid_target(td);\n  if (result != 0)\n    side_effect();\n  return 0;\n}'
assert project(positive)[0]=='int sample(target_definition_t *td)\n{\n  if (valid_target(td))\n    side_effect();\n  return 0;\n}'
assert 'if (!valid_target(td))' in project(positive.replace('!= 0','== 0'))[0]
negative=[positive.replace('return 0;','return result;'),positive.replace('int result;','volatile int result;'),positive.replace('valid_target(td)','unverified_helper(td)'),positive.replace('if (result != 0)','use_result(&result);\n  if (result != 0)'),positive.replace('int result;','short result;'),positive.replace('  result = valid_target(td);','  /*\n  result = valid_target(td);'),positive.replace('    side_effect();','    side_effect();\n#define REWRITE result')]
assert all(project(b) is None for b in negative)
ledger=json.loads(Path('docs/recovery-evidence/helper-canonicalization.json').read_bytes())
header=read('manalink.h')
for h in helpers:assert re.search(r'\bint\s+'+h+r'\(',header),h
rows=[]
for f in ledger['files']:
 if not f['source'].endswith('.c'):continue
 text=read(f['source']);code=mask(text)
 heads=list(re.finditer(r'(?m)^\w[^;{}\n]*\b(?P<name>\w+)\([^;{}\n]*\)\s*\n?\{',code))
 counts=collections.Counter(m['name'] for m in heads)
 for head in heads:
  if counts[head['name']]!=1:continue
  depth=1;end=head.end()
  while end<len(code) and depth:
   depth+=(code[end]=='{')-(code[end]=='}');end+=1
  if depth:continue
  body=text[head.start():end];proposal=project(body)
  if proposal:
   assert span(text,head['name'])==(head.start(),end)
   after,details=proposal
   rows.append(dict(name=head['name'],source=f['source'],before=body,after=after,before_sha256=sha(body.encode()),after_sha256=sha(after.encode()),kind='mechanical_single_use_int_predicate',reason='Remove unescaped int temporary with exactly three code identifiers: top-level declaration, adjacent known-int helper assignment, and zero/nonzero test. Preserve evaluation point, helper arguments, branch body, call order and all other source bytes. This is source cleanup, not an additional native body review.',projection=details))
out=dict(format=1,source_edits=rows,scanner_sha256=sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()),controls=dict(positive=2,negative=len(negative)),header_sha256=sha(Path('manalink.h').read_bytes()),scope='No source writes. Reject non-int declarations, other result uses, escapes, unknown helper returns, helper shadowing, preprocessing and assembly. No reccmp annotation or gameplay equivalence inferred.')
Path('.recovery/reccmp/predicate-plan-c715.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Mechanical source cleanups:',len(rows),'definitions in',len({r['source'] for r in rows}),'files; 2 positive /',len(negative),'negative controls')
